mechanism: Armodafinil may increase CNS stimulation and potentially antagonize haloperidol's antipsychotic effects while both drugs affect dopaminergic and noradrenergic systems; haloperidol may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of armodafinil.
action: Monitor for reduced antipsychotic efficacy and increased CNS stimulation; consider alternative stimulant or dose adjustment; ensure close psychiatric and neurological monitoring.
